Today’s episode continues with Amma of Swamy family decides to go on a Trip to Tirupati Balaji temple for 2 days. The tickets are booked and everything is planned but at the very last moment Teja, Bhanu and their two children’s were unable to board on their reserved bogie! Want to know what happened next?
